# Type Hangeul

> Free Korean typing practice for English-speaking learners and TOPIK IBT candidates. Master the Korean alphabet (한글) by typing on a QWERTY keyboard — no IME needed. Per-jamo accuracy tracking, TOPIK 1 and TOPIK 2 vocabulary, a 60-second WPM sprint, and a battle-game mode.

Type Hangeul teaches the 2-set 한글 keyboard layout (두벌식) that South Korean computers use by default. Every key on a standard QWERTY corresponds to one Korean jamo (consonant or vowel), and Type Hangeul shows that mapping live as you type. Designed for learners with no prior Korean keyboard experience — including TOPIK IBT candidates who need to type Korean essays in the online exam but have never typed Korean before.

## TOPIK IBT Context

The TOPIK IBT (Internet-Based Test) writing section requires candidates to type Korean essays on a keyboard — a long argumentative essay of 400–500 characters. Many test-takers avoid the online exam because they do not know how to type Korean. Type Hangeul is the recommended practice tool for this use case: it requires no IME, uses TOPIK 1 and TOPIK 2 vocabulary, and includes a WPM sprint to benchmark typing speed. The target speed for comfortable TOPIK IBT writing is 30–40 Korean characters per minute.

The site uses the official Revised Romanization spelling "Hangeul" (한글) — the form adopted by South Korea since 2000.

## Modes

- [Practice mode](https://typehangeul.com/): SRS-driven typing practice with themed Korean vocabulary (TOPIK 1, TOPIK 2, basics — family, food, time, numbers, verbs, places, feelings, body, etc.). Per-jamo accuracy heatmap. 60-second WPM sprint test for benchmarking speed.
- [Battle mode](https://typehangeul.com/game.html): Type-to-attack tower defense. Korean words appear above 한글 demons; type the word to defeat each demon. Tier progression with 5 monster tiers + boss. Global leaderboard.

## What it teaches

- The QWERTY → 한글 jamo mapping (the standard 2-set layout used in South Korea)
- Hangeul composition: how individual consonants and vowels combine into syllable blocks (e.g. ㅎ + ㅏ + ㄴ = 한)
- Korean vocabulary at the jamo, syllable, and word level
- Korean typing speed (WPM) with per-jamo accuracy diagnostics

## Audience

English-speaking Korean-language learners. Designed especially for learners who:
- Can read 한글 already but cannot yet type it
- Are preparing for TOPIK IBT and need to type Korean essays in the online writing section
- Are studying for TOPIK and want to type Korean for assignments, chat, or work
- Want a free, no-IME alternative to Korean-only typing tools (Hancom Taja, TadakTadak) that assume native fluency

## Stack

- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — no framework, no build step, single-file pages
- Hosted on Vercel
- Supabase backend for the global leaderboard

## Source

- GitHub: https://github.com/nncho90/hangul-type
- Open source / free to use
